title: Spring 2027 Graphic Design Internship
description_raw:
This position reports to the Sr. Graphic Designer and supports our team of project managers and account coordinators. This internship will correspond with your educational study/school credit requirements. In addition to significant professional development, mentorship, and real-world project experience, participants will be considered for a one-time, performance-based payment at the conclusion of the program. The amount depends on business and individual results.
Salary: Up to $500 / yearOriginally posted on Himalayas
